title: Free Berlin Memorials - Quick Summary
items: **Start with one question, not four addresses.** The Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe helps you slow down before Topography of Terror explains the machinery behind the crimes.
**Choose two places for a focused visit.** Add the Berlin Wall Memorial when you want the later divided city to become visible in the ground and streets.
**Use Tränenpalast as a human ending.** The former Friedrichstraße border crossing brings the story back to people making decisions at a checkpoint.
**Check every official page before leaving.** Free admission does not remove opening-hour changes, Monday closures or public-holiday arrangements.
Use the Berlin Memorial Reading Order to arrange two, three or four places around the question you still want to answer.
